Central Austin: less time on the market, a lower median price.

October 2026 home sales in Community Impact’s nine-ZIP Central Austin coverage area averaged 62 days on the market, compared with 78 in October 2025.

The median sale price was $825,000, down from $894,000 a year earlier. Closed sales totaled 146, down 17.5% year over year.

Why it matters: a shorter selling timeline can coexist with a lower median price and fewer transactions. These figures describe the homes that sold; the median change does not measure the value change of an individual home.

For buyers and sellers, compare recent sales in your ZIP code and price range before applying this snapshot to your property search or pricing decision.

Source: Community Impact, Nov. 17, 2026, citing Unlock MLS.
